column1: # The lattice in seagraph.py is generated: it drops a waypoint every 32 tiles
# of open water with 6 tiles of clearance.  That covers the ocean but cannot
# thread a channel narrower than it, so the straits stay unconnected.
# This file is where those are fixed by hand.  A row is a point of open water
# a ship can sit in, in game coordinates.  Hand waypoints are exempt from the
# clearance rule - you looked at the map, the generator did not - but they are
# NOT exempt from the water check: a waypoint on land, or a leg that would
# cross land, is still refused.  Place a few in a row to thread a channel;
# they chain to each other and pick up the open lattice at both ends.
# `python3 -m routing.chart.check` reports which port pairs are still routing
# the long way round, and roughly where the missing link is.
# x, y are world coordinates - the same ones in locations.tsv.
